title: Van Dedem (Constantinople) to Van de Spiegel and the Agent van Staat, 1788-1799 (DECODE R2120, R2122, R2131, R1895)

steps.what: Fetched metadata and images for the 4 records and 10 sibling records named in the DECODE notes.
Sibling records R2121, R1947 and R2053 are marked decrypted; R2121 holds the same cipher pages as R2120 plus their full clear decipherment.
Searched DECODE key records; checked the undated Fagel key series R2842-R2852, which are large alphabetical Dutch codebooks and not this code.
Transcribed R2122 and R2131, and the R2121, R1947 and R2053 cipher pages and their solutions (two agents).
Found heavy homophony (de x36 in the clear text, no group used more than 11 times) and that only 52-58% of the target groups occur in any crib.
Tested an alphabetical code order against anchored words.
Hard-EM, then leave-one-out word aligners with restarts, over the cipher and decipherment pairs.
Treated the hundreds digit as a dummy (thousands digit + last two digits) and re-aligned.

outcome.method_basis: R2120 was found already deciphered at the time (its full clear decipherment is filed as R2121); crib alignment against R2121, R1947 and R2053 gave no consistent key for the heavily homophonic code, so R2122, R2131 and R1895 are unread.
outcome.notes: R2120 was already read at the time (R2121). R2122, R2131 and R1895 are unread; the codebook or more Dutch cribs are needed.

prior.where: R2120: the contemporary clear decipherment was filed as R2121. R2122 and R2131: none found.

human: The human supplied the target and the DECODE cookie.
